lci.text: Amalia Benavides Aguirre travels with Vito's expedition into the caverns of Ixalan, haunted by visions of sand, fire and a golden door, and when the expedition reaches a golden door in the catacombs, she sees it is not the door from her visions.
She uses her enchanted quill to alter her map, removing part of a bridge so that pursuers fall, and she takes responsibility for the stranger Kellan when Vito refuses to help him.

Amalia and Kellan step through the golden door into the Core, a hollow world that matches her visions, but when the starving Legion soldiers feed on their own servants, she erases a wall from her map and she and Kellan flee.

She carves a fissure in front of the Mycotyrant's army, then tells Kellan she feels she has been living a lie about her faith, and when Vito kills Bartolomé for protecting them, she chooses to leave her world with Kellan through the Omenpath.
